verdict.rationale: WorkOS emits events: Directory Sync automatically pushes updates for directories, groups, users and access rules, delivered via webhooks or retrievable through the Events API. That gives developers triggers they can wire to actions in their own code. However, the evidence shows no built-in rule engine, workflow builder or event-triggered actions configurable inside WorkOS, so the user must build the rule logic externally. Missing for 10: a native rule/automation definition capability, actions triggered automatically within the platform, coverage of event types beyond Directory Sync, and hands-on corroboration.
